# rcolapi

`rcolapi` is an R client for the [Catalogue of
Life](https://www.catalogueoflife.org) via the
[ChecklistBank](https://www.checklistbank.org) API
(<https://api.checklistbank.org>). It allows you to verify and match
scientific names, retrieve hierarchical classifications, look up
datasets, taxa, synonyms, vernacular names, and geographic
distributions, and run ChecklistBank parsers — against **any** public
dataset in ChecklistBank or the latest Catalogue of Life release. It is
modelled on the conventions of
[`rgbif`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rgbif/) and
[`taxadb`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxadb/).

> **Note on Origin & Architectural Evolution**: This package builds upon
> the original [`rcol` project by Catalogue of
> Life](https://github.com/CatalogueOfLife/rcol)
> (<https://catalogueoflife.github.io/rcol/>). This version introduces
> substantial architectural enhancements to simplify scientific
> workflows, including:
>
> - **Direct Scientific Name Support**: Pass scientific names directly
>   (e.g., `"Panthera leo"` or `"Werneria nubigena"`) to downstream
>   functions without needing prior manual ID lookups.
> - **Vectorized Multi-Species Queries**: Seamlessly pass character
>   vectors of multiple species (e.g.,
>   `c("Werneria nubigena", "Panthera leo")`) and receive clean,
>   concatenated tidy data frames.
> - **Distribution Traceability**: Multi-species distributions include
>   `input_row` and `scientific_name`, preserving their association with
>   the original input.
> - **Clean Name Verification**:
>   [`col_check_name()`](https://paulesantos.github.io/rcolapi/reference/clb_resolve_name.md)
>   returns an essential 9-column resolution summary showing accepted
>   names, status, and IDs.
> - **Flexible Classification Extraction**:
>   [`col_classification()`](https://paulesantos.github.io/rcolapi/reference/col_shortcuts.md)
>   supports both Long format and Wide format (`wide = TRUE`).

There are two parallel families of functions:

- **`col_*()`** convenience functions that target the **latest extended
  Catalogue of Life release** (`"3LXR"`). On first use, the release key
  is pinned in session
  ([`col_key()`](https://paulesantos.github.io/rcolapi/reference/col_key.md)),
  ensuring long-running jobs are never disrupted by mid-session release
  updates. Use
  [`col_refresh()`](https://paulesantos.github.io/rcolapi/reference/col_refresh.md)
  to re-pin.
- **`clb_*()`** universal low-level functions that accept an explicit
  `dataset =` argument (e.g., `"COL25"`, `2099`) to query any dataset in
  ChecklistBank.

## Installation

The package is now named `rcolapi`; load it with
[`library(rcolapi)`](https://github.com/PaulESantos/rcolapi). The
`col_*()` and `clb_*()` function names are unchanged. This package is
not the archived CRAN package `rcol`. The GitHub repository is
`PaulESantos/rcolapi`.

Version 0.0.2 is being prepared for CRAN submission. Until it is
accepted, install this version from GitHub:

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("PaulESantos/rcolapi")

# or
# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("PaulESantos/rcolapi")
```

Documentation is published at <https://paulesantos.github.io/rcolapi/>.

After CRAN accepts `rcolapi`, the CRAN installation command will be:

``` r

install.packages("rcolapi")
```

## Quick start

### 1. Name Verification & Matching

``` r

library(rcolapi)

# High-level clean verification (9 columns) for 1 or multiple species
col_check_name(c("Werneria nubigena", "Panthera leo", "Schinus molle"))
#> # A tibble: 3 × 9
#>   queried_name      matched_name      status   accepted_name accepted_authorship
#>   <chr>             <chr>             <chr>    <chr>         <chr>              
#> 1 Werneria nubigena Werneria nubigena synonym  Rockhausenia… (Kunth) D.J.N.Hind 
#> 2 Panthera leo      Panthera leo      accepted Panthera leo  (Linnaeus, 1758)   
#> 3 Schinus molle     Schinus molle     accepted Schinus molle L.                 
#> # ℹ 4 more variables: accepted_rank <chr>, accepted_id <chr>, match <lgl>,
#> #   match_type <chr>

# Detailed matching against the latest Catalogue of Life release
col_match("Panthera leo")
#> # A tibble: 1 × 17
#>   match match_type usage_id name         authorship     rank  status accepted_id
#>   <lgl> <chr>      <chr>    <chr>        <chr>          <chr> <chr>  <chr>      
#> 1 TRUE  variant    4CGXP    Panthera leo (Linnaeus, 17… spec… accep… 4CGXP      
#> # ℹ 9 more variables: accepted_name <chr>, accepted_authorship <chr>,
#> #   accepted_rank <chr>, code <chr>, label <chr>, parent_id <chr>,
#> #   names_index_id <int>, names_index_match_type <chr>, classification <list>

# Disambiguate with rank and nomenclatural code
col_match("Abies alba", rank = "species", code = "botanical")
#> # A tibble: 1 × 17
#>   match match_type usage_id name       authorship rank    status   accepted_id
#>   <lgl> <chr>      <chr>    <chr>      <chr>      <chr>   <chr>    <chr>      
#> 1 TRUE  variant    8K9Y     Abies alba Mill.      species accepted 8K9Y       
#> # ℹ 9 more variables: accepted_name <chr>, accepted_authorship <chr>,
#> #   accepted_rank <chr>, code <chr>, label <chr>, parent_id <chr>,
#> #   names_index_id <int>, names_index_match_type <chr>, classification <list>

# See all candidate matches (homonyms), not just the best one
col_match_verbose("Oenanthe")
#> # A tibble: 2 × 16
#>   primary usage_id name     authorship    rank  status accepted_id accepted_name
#>   <lgl>   <chr>    <chr>    <chr>         <chr> <chr>  <chr>       <chr>        
#> 1 FALSE   679P     Oenanthe Vieillot, 18… genus accep… 679P        Oenanthe     
#> 2 FALSE   679Q     Oenanthe L.            genus accep… 679Q        Oenanthe     
#> # ℹ 8 more variables: accepted_authorship <chr>, accepted_rank <chr>,
#> #   code <chr>, label <chr>, parent_id <chr>, names_index_id <int>,
#> #   names_index_match_type <chr>, classification <list>

# Match many names at once in parallel
col_match_checklist(c("Panthera leo", "Bufo bufo", "Abies alba"))
#> # A tibble: 3 × 19
#>   verbatim_name match match_type usage_id name         authorship   rank  status
#>   <chr>         <lgl> <chr>      <chr>    <chr>        <chr>        <chr> <chr> 
#> 1 Panthera leo  TRUE  variant    4CGXP    Panthera leo (Linnaeus, … spec… accep…
#> 2 Bufo bufo     TRUE  variant    NP2D     Bufo bufo    (Linnaeus, … spec… accep…
#> 3 Abies alba    TRUE  variant    8K9Y     Abies alba   Mill.        spec… accep…
#> # ℹ 11 more variables: accepted_id <chr>, accepted_name <chr>,
#> #   accepted_authorship <chr>, accepted_rank <chr>, code <chr>, label <chr>,
#> #   parent_id <chr>, names_index_id <int>, names_index_match_type <chr>,
#> #   classification <list>, error <chr>
```

To match against a specific dataset instead of the latest COL release,
use the `clb_*()` form with a `dataset =` key or alias:

``` r

clb_match("Felis catus", dataset = "COL25")          # 2025 annual release
#> # A tibble: 1 × 17
#>   match match_type usage_id name        authorship     rank   status accepted_id
#>   <lgl> <chr>      <chr>    <chr>       <chr>          <chr>  <chr>  <chr>      
#> 1 TRUE  variant    3DXV3    Felis catus Linnaeus, 1758 speci… accep… 3DXV3      
#> # ℹ 9 more variables: accepted_name <chr>, accepted_authorship <chr>,
#> #   accepted_rank <chr>, code <chr>, label <chr>, parent_id <chr>,
#> #   names_index_id <int>, names_index_match_type <chr>, classification <list>
clb_match("Macrocystis pyrifera", dataset = 2099)    # public dataset by key
#> # A tibble: 1 × 17
#>   match match_type usage_id name  authorship rank  status accepted_id
#>   <lgl> <chr>      <chr>    <chr> <chr>      <chr> <chr>  <chr>      
#> 1 FALSE none       <NA>     <NA>  <NA>       <NA>  <NA>   <NA>       
#> # ℹ 9 more variables: accepted_name <chr>, accepted_authorship <chr>,
#> #   accepted_rank <chr>, code <chr>, label <chr>, parent_id <chr>,
#> #   names_index_id <chr>, names_index_match_type <chr>, classification <list>
```

### 2. Classification, Synonyms, Vernaculars & Distribution

The following lookup functions accept scientific names, IDs, vectors, or
match result tables:

``` r

# Hierarchical classification in Wide or Long format
col_classification("Schinus molle", wide = TRUE)
#> # A tibble: 1 × 10
#>   id    name          rank    kingdom phylum    class order family genus species
#>   <chr> <chr>         <chr>   <chr>   <chr>     <chr> <chr> <chr>  <chr> <chr>  
#> 1 4V8GC Schinus molle species Plantae Tracheop… Magn… Sapi… Anaca… Schi… Schinu…

# Synonyms for 1 or multiple species
col_synonyms(c("Werneria nubigena", "Panthera leo"))
#> # A tibble: 16 × 6
#>    accepted_name         scientific_name authorship synonym_type rank  full_name
#>    <chr>                 <chr>           <chr>      <chr>        <chr> <chr>    
#>  1 Rockhausenia nubigena Werneria nubig… Kunth      homotypic    spec… Werneria…
#>  2 Rockhausenia nubigena Oresigonia gra… Willd. ex… heterotypic  spec… Oresigon…
#>  3 Rockhausenia nubigena Oresigonia lat… Willd. ex… heterotypic  spec… Oresigon…
#>  4 Rockhausenia nubigena Oribasia acaul… DC.        heterotypic  spec… Oribasia…
#>  5 Rockhausenia nubigena Werneria disti… Kunth      heterotypic  spec… Werneria…
#>  6 Rockhausenia nubigena Werneria dombe… (Wedd.) H… heterotypic  spec… Werneria…
#>  7 Rockhausenia nubigena Werneria mocin… DC.        heterotypic  spec… Werneria…
#>  8 Rockhausenia nubigena Werneria nubig… Wedd.      heterotypic  subv… Werneria…
#>  9 Rockhausenia nubigena Werneria nubig… Wedd.      heterotypic  subv… Werneria…
#> 10 Rockhausenia nubigena Werneria nubig… Wedd.      heterotypic  vari… Werneria…
#> 11 Rockhausenia nubigena Werneria nubig… Wedd.      heterotypic  vari… Werneria…
#> 12 Rockhausenia nubigena Werneria nubig… <NA>       heterotypic  vari… Werneria…
#> 13 Rockhausenia nubigena Werneria steub… Hieron.    heterotypic  spec… Werneria…
#> 14 Rockhausenia nubigena Werneria stueb… Hieron.    heterotypic  spec… Werneria…
#> 15 Panthera leo          Felis leo       Linnaeus,… homotypic    spec… Felis le…
#> 16 Panthera leo          Panthera leo n… (de Blain… heterotypic  subs… Panthera…

# Vernacular / common names with species association (scientific_name column)
col_vernacular(c("Werneria nubigena", "Panthera leo"))
#> # A tibble: 206 × 7
#>    scientific_name       name               language latin country area  remarks
#>    <chr>                 <chr>              <chr>    <chr> <chr>   <chr> <chr>  
#>  1 Rockhausenia nubigena Chicoria blanca    spa      Chic… <NA>    <NA>  <NA>   
#>  2 Rockhausenia nubigena Cóndor cebolla     spa      Cond… <NA>    <NA>  <NA>   
#>  3 Panthera leo          African Lion       eng      Afri… <NA>    <NA>  <NA>   
#>  4 Panthera leo          Afrikaanse Leeuw   nld      Afri… <NA>    <NA>  Contri…
#>  5 Panthera leo          Afrikanischer Löwe deu      Afri… DE      <NA>  <NA>   
#>  6 Panthera leo          Agrzam             shi      Agrz… <NA>    <NA>  Contri…
#>  7 Panthera leo          Ambessa            amh      Ambe… <NA>    <NA>  <NA>   
#>  8 Panthera leo          Arslon             uzb      Arsl… <NA>    <NA>  Contri…
#>  9 Panthera leo          Aslan              tur      Aslan <NA>    <NA>  Contri…
#> 10 Panthera leo          Dzata              ewe      Dzata <NA>    <NA>  Contri…
#> # ℹ 196 more rows

# Geographic distribution in tidy format
col_distribution(c("Werneria nubigena", "Schinus molle"))
#> # A tibble: 54 × 3
#>    input_row scientific_name       area                                
#>        <int> <chr>                 <chr>                               
#>  1         1 Rockhausenia nubigena Mexico (Chiapas)                    
#>  2         1 Rockhausenia nubigena Guatemala

#>  8         2 Schinus molle         Portugal [I]                        
#>  9         2 Schinus molle         Spain [I]                           
#> 10         2 Schinus molle         Gibraltar [I]                       
#> # ℹ 44 more rows

# Details of a name usage
col_usage("Panthera leo")
#> # A tibble: 1 × 9
#>   id    scientific_name authorship       rank    status  label parent_id extinct
#>   <chr> <chr>           <chr>            <chr>   <chr>   <chr> <chr>     <lgl>

#> # ℹ 1 more variable: name <list>
```

### 4. Parsers

``` r

# Parse a scientific name into its atomic components
clb_parse_name("Abies alba Mill. var. alpina")
#> # A tibble: 1 × 12
#>   scientificName  rank  genus specificEpithet infraspecificEpithet type  extinct
#>   <chr>           <chr> <chr> <chr>           <chr>                <chr> <lgl>  
#> 1 Abies alba var… vari… Abies alba            alpina               scie… FALSE  
#> # ℹ 5 more variables: issues <list>, label <chr>, labelHtml <chr>,
#> #   parsed <lgl>, notho <list>
```

## Catalogue of Life Releases

The Catalogue of Life is published in two cadences (monthly and annual)
and two flavours (base and extended `XR`). Dataset-scoped `clb_*()`
functions take a `dataset =` argument; helpful aliases resolve to the
latest of each:

``` r

clb_col_release("monthly")                  # "3LR"   latest monthly base
#> [1] "3LR"
clb_col_release("monthly", extended = TRUE) # "3LXR"  latest monthly extended
#> [1] "3LXR"
clb_col_release("annual")                   # e.g. "COL25"
#> [1] "COL25"

clb_usage_search("Felidae", dataset = "COL25")
#> <clb> result: 1 rows (total: 1)
#> # A tibble: 1 × 11
#>   id    scientific_name authorship          rank  status label parent_id extinct
#>   <chr> <chr>           <chr>               <chr> <chr>  <chr> <chr>     <lgl>  
#> 1 623RM Felidae         Fischer de Waldhei… fami… accep… Feli… 4DL       FALSE  
#> # ℹ 3 more variables: name <list>, group <chr>, classification <list>
```

## Batch results and failures

[`col_match_checklist()`](https://paulesantos.github.io/rcolapi/reference/col_shortcuts.md)
and
[`clb_match_checklist()`](https://paulesantos.github.io/rcolapi/reference/clb_match_checklist.md)
keep one row per input and preserve input columns with a `verbatim_`
prefix. Inspect `match` and `error` before interpreting the results:

| `match` | `error` | Meaning                                       |
|---------|---------|-----------------------------------------------|
| `TRUE`  | `NA`    | A matching usage was returned.                |
| `FALSE` | `NA`    | The request succeeded but no match was found. |
| `NA`    | Message | The request or response parsing failed.       |

``` r

batch <- col_match_checklist(c("Panthera leo", "Schinus molle"))
failed <- batch[is.na(batch$match), ]
unmatched <- batch[!is.na(batch$match) & !batch$match, ]
matched <- batch[!is.na(batch$match) & batch$match, ]
failed[c("verbatim_name", "error")]
#> # A tibble: 0 × 2
#> # ℹ 2 variables: verbatim_name <chr>, error <chr>
```

These per-row diagnostics apply to batch requests. Failures before
requests are submitted, such as resolving
[`col_key()`](https://paulesantos.github.io/rcolapi/reference/col_key.md),
still raise an error. The simpler
[`col_check_name()`](https://paulesantos.github.io/rcolapi/reference/clb_resolve_name.md)
summary retains `match = NA` for failed rows but does not include the
`error` column; use
[`col_match_checklist()`](https://paulesantos.github.io/rcolapi/reference/col_shortcuts.md)
when diagnosing failures.

## Distribution provenance and raw responses

For multiple inputs,
[`col_distribution()`](https://paulesantos.github.io/rcolapi/reference/clb_distribution.md)
includes `input_row` (the one-based position in the input),
`scientific_name`, and `area`. A species can have several rows after
splitting semicolon-separated areas. Species with no distribution
records contribute no rows, so use `input_row` rather than row position
to join results back to your input.

``` r

species <- c("Panthera leo", "Schinus molle")
distribution <- col_distribution(species)
distribution$queried_name <- species[distribution$input_row]

# Add status, gazetteer, remarks and reference metadata
col_distribution(species, full = TRUE)
#> # A tibble: 49 × 7
#>    input_row scientific_name area          gazetteer status remarks reference_id
#>        <int> <chr>           <chr>         <chr>     <chr>  <chr>   <chr>       
#>  1         1 Panthera leo    Africa        text      <NA>   <NA>    <NA>        
#>  2         1 Panthera leo    Southern Asia text      <NA>   <NA>    <NA>        
#>  3         2 Schinus molle   Portugal [I]  text      <NA>   <NA>    <NA>        
#>  4         2 Schinus molle   Spain [I]     text      <NA>   <NA>    <NA>        
#>  5         2 Schinus molle   Gibraltar [I] text      <NA>   <NA>    <NA>        
#>  6         2 Schinus molle   Baleares [I]  text      <NA>   <NA>    <NA>        
#>  7         2 Schinus molle   Italy [I]     text      <NA>   <NA>    <NA>        
#>  8         2 Schinus molle   Sicily [I]    text      <NA>   <NA>    <NA>        
#>  9         2 Schinus molle   Croatia [I]   text      <NA>   <NA>    <NA>        
#> 10         2 Schinus molle   Morocco [I]   text      <NA>   <NA>    <NA>        
#> # ℹ 39 more rows

# Resolve an ID or a verification result before formatting the classification
col_classification("4CGXP", wide = TRUE)
#> # A tibble: 1 × 10
#>   id    name         rank    kingdom  phylum   class  order family genus species
#>   <chr> <chr>        <chr>   <chr>    <chr>    <chr>  <chr> <chr>  <chr> <chr>  
#> 1 4CGXP Panthera leo species Animalia Chordata Mamma… Carn… Felid… Pant… Panthe…
verified <- col_check_name("Schinus molle")
col_classification(verified, wide = TRUE)
#> # A tibble: 1 × 10
#>   id    name          rank    kingdom phylum    class order family genus species
#>   <chr> <chr>         <chr>   <chr>   <chr>     <chr> <chr> <chr>  <chr> <chr>  
#> 1 4V8GC Schinus molle species Plantae Tracheop… Magn… Sapi… Anaca… Schi… Schinu…

# Keep nested API responses intact and aligned with each input
responses <- col_usage(species, .raw = TRUE)
responses[[1]]
#> $created
#> [1] "2026-10-07T19:40:07.596881"
#> 
#> $createdBy
#> [1] 102

#> [1] 316691
#> 
#> $id
#> [1] "4CGXP"
#> 
#> $sectorKey
#> [1] 1508
#> 
#> $verbatimSourceKey

#>

#> $name$basionymAuthorship
#> $name$basionymAuthorship$authors
#> $name$basionymAuthorship$authors[[1]]

#> 
#>

#> [1] "1758"
#>

#> [1] "zoological"

#> [1] "acceptable"

#> [1] "69532ae1-a582-4c70-87b7-0bbfbf8eb10a"
#>

#> [1] "source"
#> 
#> $name$type
#> [1] "scientific"
#> 
#> $name$link
#> [1] "https://www.itis.gov/servlet/SingleRpt/SingleRpt?search_topic=TSN&search_value=183803"
#> 
#> $name$remarks
#> [1] "http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/NOMEN_0000224"
#> 
#> $name$parsed
#> [1] TRUE
#> 
#> $name$notho
#> list()
#> 
#> 
#> $status
#> [1] "accepted"
#> 
#> $origin
#> [1] "source"
#> 
#> $parentId
#> [1] "6DBT"
#> 
#> $identifier
#> $identifier[[1]]
#> [1] "taxref:644245"
#> 
#> $identifier[[2]]
#> [1] "inat:41964"
#> 
#> 
#> $link
#> [1] "https://www.itis.gov/servlet/SingleRpt/SingleRpt?search_topic=TSN&search_value=183803"
#> 
#> $referenceIds
#> $referenceIds[[1]]
#> [1] "db07644c-53fa-4cfe-9306-760c08c39b61"
#> 
#> $referenceIds[[2]]
#> [1] "f167ab3e-4852-4af8-9154-dba859ffd8e0"
#> 
#> $referenceIds[[3]]
#> [1] "955f35f3-b560-4f56-bb7b-6de2c0154153"
#> 
#> $referenceIds[[4]]
#> [1] "2f2283ae-4abb-49bc-8840-c3af8bd6236e"
#> 
#> $referenceIds[[5]]
#> [1] "80052a63-d318-41d8-b039-559debeebbb2"
#> 
#> $referenceIds[[6]]
#> [1] "93f9dbd1-0527-4207-9d23-b3ff7e2067ed"
#> 
#> 
#> $scrutinizer
#> [1] "W. Christopher Wozencraft,Alfred L. Gardner"
#> 
#> $scrutinizerDate
#> [1] "2024-06-25"
#> 
#> $extinct
#> [1] FALSE
#> 
#> $label
#> [1] "Panthera leo (Linnaeus, 1758)"
#> 
#> $labelHtml
#> [1] "<i>Panthera leo</i> (Linnaeus, 1758)"
```

For a single input, distribution output defaults to `area`;
`full = TRUE` also includes `scientific_name` and metadata. Usage,
classification, synonym, vernacular and distribution lookups with
multiple inputs and `.raw = TRUE` return a list of complete parsed
responses, including empty responses, instead of combining them into a
tibble. With one input, `.raw = TRUE` returns the single parsed
response. For classification, `.raw = TRUE` takes precedence over
`wide`.

When passing a result table to a taxon lookup, valid IDs are selected in
order from `accepted_id`, `usage_id`, and `id`, skipping missing or
empty values. Unresolved rows raise an error. Filter failed and
unmatched rows before passing a batch result to a downstream lookup.

## Building documentation and running tests

Online examples are displayed without execution when the README and
vignettes are built. This allows documentation builds without contacting
ChecklistBank. Unit tests run without API access; live integration tests
are opt-in and remain skipped on CRAN.

``` r

devtools::test()

# Run live integration tests in a development session with Internet access
withr::with_envvar(c(RCOL_LIVE_TESTS = "true"), devtools::test())

# Build and check the package, including its vignettes and PDF manual
devtools::check(cran = TRUE, manual = TRUE)
```

Documentation builds require Pandoc; the PDF manual also requires a
working LaTeX installation. These tools are separate from access to the
API.

## Configuration

The base URL defaults to the production API and can be redirected with
the `CLB_BASE_URL` environment variable:

``` r

Sys.setenv(CLB_BASE_URL = "https://api.dev.checklistbank.org")
```

## Universal ChecklistBank Interface (CLB)

Low-level complementary functions (`clb_*` family) for advanced queries
against any specific ChecklistBank dataset or historical COL release.

- [`clb_resolve_name()`](https://paulesantos.github.io/rcolapi/reference/clb_resolve_name.md)
  [`col_resolve_name()`](https://paulesantos.github.io/rcolapi/reference/clb_resolve_name.md)
  [`col_check_name()`](https://paulesantos.github.io/rcolapi/reference/clb_resolve_name.md)
  [`clb_check_name()`](https://paulesantos.github.io/rcolapi/reference/clb_resolve_name.md)
  : Resolve and verify valid species names
- [`clb_match()`](https://paulesantos.github.io/rcolapi/reference/clb_match.md)
  : Match a scientific name against a ChecklistBank dataset
- [`clb_match_checklist()`](https://paulesantos.github.io/rcolapi/reference/clb_match_checklist.md)
  : Match a checklist of names in bulk
- [`clb_match_verbose()`](https://paulesantos.github.io/rcolapi/reference/clb_match_verbose.md)
  : Match a name and return all candidate usages
- [`clb_classification()`](https://paulesantos.github.io/rcolapi/reference/clb_classification.md)
  : Classification hierarchy of a taxon
- [`clb_extract_classification()`](https://paulesantos.github.io/rcolapi/reference/clb_extract_classification.md)
  [`col_extract_classification()`](https://paulesantos.github.io/rcolapi/reference/clb_extract_classification.md)
  : Extract taxonomic classification from a match or usage result
- [`clb_synonyms()`](https://paulesantos.github.io/rcolapi/reference/clb_synonyms.md)
  : Synonyms of a taxon
- [`clb_vernacular()`](https://paulesantos.github.io/rcolapi/reference/clb_vernacular.md)
  : Vernacular (common) names
- [`clb_distribution()`](https://paulesantos.github.io/rcolapi/reference/clb_distribution.md)
  [`col_distribution()`](https://paulesantos.github.io/rcolapi/reference/clb_distribution.md)
  : Geographic distribution for a taxon
- [`clb_usage()`](https://paulesantos.github.io/rcolapi/reference/clb_usage.md)
  : Get a name usage (taxon or synonym) by id
- [`clb_usage_search()`](https://paulesantos.github.io/rcolapi/reference/clb_usage_search.md)
  [`clb_search()`](https://paulesantos.github.io/rcolapi/reference/clb_usage_search.md)
  : Full-text search of name usages
- [`clb_suggest()`](https://paulesantos.github.io/rcolapi/reference/clb_suggest.md)
  : Autocomplete suggestions for name usages
- [`clb_usage_metrics()`](https://paulesantos.github.io/rcolapi/reference/clb_usage_metrics.md)
  : Metrics for a taxon
- [`clb_tree()`](https://paulesantos.github.io/rcolapi/reference/clb_tree.md)
  : Navigate the taxonomic tree
- [`clb_children()`](https://paulesantos.github.io/rcolapi/reference/clb_children.md)
  : Direct children of a taxon
- [`clb_dataset()`](https://paulesantos.github.io/rcolapi/reference/clb_dataset.md)
  : Get dataset metadata
- [`clb_dataset_search()`](https://paulesantos.github.io/rcolapi/reference/clb_dataset_search.md)
  : Search datasets in ChecklistBank
- [`clb_dataset_metrics()`](https://paulesantos.github.io/rcolapi/reference/clb_dataset_metrics.md)
  : Dataset metrics
- [`clb_col_release()`](https://paulesantos.github.io/rcolapi/reference/clb_col_release.md)
  : Resolve a Catalogue of Life release
- [`clb_col_releases()`](https://paulesantos.github.io/rcolapi/reference/clb_col_releases.md)
  : List all Catalogue of Life releases
- [`clb_base_url()`](https://paulesantos.github.io/rcolapi/reference/clb_base_url.md)
  : The ChecklistBank API base URL

## ChecklistBank Parsers

Tools for parsing scientific names into atomic epithets and parsing
controlled values.

- [`clb_parse_name()`](https://paulesantos.github.io/rcolapi/reference/clb_parse_name.md)
  : Parse scientific names
- [`clb_parsers()`](https://paulesantos.github.io/rcolapi/reference/clb_parsers.md)
  : List the available ChecklistBank parsers
- [`clb_parse()`](https://paulesantos.github.io/rcolapi/reference/clb_parse.md)
  : Parse values with a ChecklistBank value parser
